works: A JPEG, PNG or TIFF without georeference tags dropped in a batch is recognised by signature, read natively (no model, no provider) by a fenced intake-page-image job, given one bounded preview, and rests read / needs_answer asking what it shows; the officer's answer is kept as a candidate label.

design.recognition: Probe: JPEG and PNG by signature (family image); a TIFF is family image when its first IFD, read from the head or the tail, has none of tags 33550, 33922, 34264, 34735. Any of those keeps it raster (D4). The file name is never used.
design.pass1: page-image-read.ts parses JPEG SOF/JFIF/Exif, PNG IHDR/pHYs/eXIf, TIFF IFD0 + Exif IFD: width, height, bands, bit depth, EXIF orientation, DateTimeOriginal as stated, GPS presence (not read), DPI as stated. Unknown stays null.
design.preview: libvips (sharp 0.35.4): orientation applied, longest side 1,024 px, PNG, stored content-addressed at page-image-previews/<sourceId>/<sha256>.png; the read names its original (sourceId, revision, sha256).
design.bounds: Whole original read only up to 128 MiB (compressed bytes in memory, hash-checked); above that only the first 1 MiB is read for header facts and no preview is made, and the item says so. Decoding refuses inputs above 250,000,000 pixels before decoding; JPEG decodes with shrink-on-load (DCT scaling), PNG and stripped TIFF line-sequentially, so no full-size pixel buffer is held. Preview at most 8 MiB.
design.item: state read, placement needs_answer, limitReason in officer words, e.g. 'A 2,776 x 1,346 PNG image, no location stated. Kept for review as a page image. What does it show: a plan, an elevation, a photo or something else?'. The read is kept under plan_ref.pageImage and exposed as IntakeItem.pageImage.
design.answer: POST /api/v1/ingestion/cases/{caseId}/intake/items/{itemId}/page-image-label {requestKey, label: plan|elevation|photo|other}; stored as label {value, state: candidate, answeredAt}; placement undecided; same-key replay stored in operations.
